signIn.title: Come back into the shade
signIn.body: Your bookings, your orders and the dishes you avoid, remembered on every visit.

code.sent: We have sent a six-digit code to {email}. It works for ten minutes.
code.label: The code
code.resent: A new code is on its way.
code.hint: No password needed. If you are new, this creates your account.

signUp.title: Keep a shade of your own
signUp.body: Save your addresses and favourite dishes, tell us once what you avoid, and collect points on every visit.
signUp.marketing: Send me the seasonal letter (four a year).

reset.title: A new password
reset.body: Write your email and we will send a link to choose a new password. The link works for an hour.
reset.sent: If {email} has an account with us, the link is on its way.

resetNew.title: Choose a new password
resetNew.body: Use at least eight characters; a short sentence is easier to remember than a code.
resetNew.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with it now.
resetNew.invalid: This link has expired or has already been used.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.
errors.userExists: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidOtp: That code is not right. Check the latest email.
errors.otpExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries with that code. Ask for a new one.
errors.invalidToken: This link has expired or has already been used.
errors.invalidPassword: Your current password is not right.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

overview.intro: Everything you keep with us, in one place.

loyalty.title: Membership
loyalty.top: You are in our highest tier.

dietary.title: What you avoid
dietary.none: Tell us once about allergies and diets, and the menu will mark what suits you.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: Confirm {email} to see the bookings, orders and gift cards you made before you had an account.
verify.sent: We have sent a code to {email}.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: How we greet you, and how we reach you about a booking or an order.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailNote: To change your email, write to us from the contact page.

password.title: Password
password.others: Also sign out of my other devices
password.setBody: You sign in with a code by email. Add a password if you would rather use one.
password.setDone: Password added. You can now sign in with either.

sessions.title: Devices
sessions.body: Signed in on a phone or a computer you no longer use?
sessions.revoked: You are signed out everywhere else.

dietary.title: Dietary profile
dietary.intro: We mark the dishes that suit you on the menu, on the order page and on every dish. The kitchen will still ask at the table, so tell whoever serves you too.
dietary.avoidHint: Dishes that contain them are flagged, never hidden, so you always see the whole menu.
dietary.saved: Saved. The menu now marks what suits you.
dietary.preview: On today's menus: {suits} of {total} dishes suit you.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.intro: Saved for delivery, so checkout takes a tap.
addresses.none: No addresses yet. Add one here, or save it when you order.
addresses.label: Call it
addresses.notesHint: A landmark, the gate colour, which entrance.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.intro: The dishes you have saved. Tap the heart on any dish to add it here.

orders.title: Orders
orders.intro: Every order from your account, newest first.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.intro: Your tables and your seats at our gatherings.

giftCards.title: Gift cards
giftCards.intro: Cards given to you, and cards you have given.
giftCards.noneReceived: No cards given to you yet.
giftCards.noneGiven: You have not given a card yet.
giftCards.use: Use it at checkout online, or show the code at the house.
giftCards.verify: Confirm your email on the account page to see cards sent to you.

loyalty.title: Membership
loyalty.intro: The Shade Circle: points on every visit, a tier that grows with you.
loyalty.redeem: Use your points at checkout: every {points} take {amount} off.
loyalty.noHistory: No points yet. They arrive with your first order.

preferences.title: Messages from us
preferences.intro: We write rarely. Choose what reaches you.
preferences.email: The seasonal letter by email, four times a year
preferences.sms: A text message when a gathering opens at your house
preferences.service: Messages about your bookings and orders always reach you; they are part of the service.
preferences.pending: Saved. Confirm the letter from the email we have just sent.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What we keep is yours to take away or to erase.

export.title: Download your data
export.body: One file with your profile, addresses, favourites, orders, bookings, tickets, gift cards and points.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.body: We remove your profile, addresses, favourites, points and dietary profile, and sign you out everywhere. Past orders and bookings stay in our books without your name or contact details, as tax rules require for invoices.
delete.cancels: {count, plural, one {Your upcoming booking will be cancelled.} other {Your {n} upcoming bookings will be cancelled.}}
delete.blocked: Some things need to finish first:
delete.blockReservation: Booking {code} on {date} is inside the change window; call the house to cancel it.
delete.blockTicket: Your ticket {code} is for a gathering on {date}.
delete.done: Your account is deleted. Thank you for the time you spent in our shade.
